correctness_confidence.basis: All structural theorems are formally verified in Lean 4.36.0 with zero sorries and zero Classical.choice, and computations are audited via 16 SHA-256 certificates and 71 adversarial pytest checks.

rigor.basis: Rigorous algebraic number theory combining arithmetic invariants, cubic residuacity, quadratic reciprocity, modular covering sieves, and exact finite field factorization kernel-orbit matching.

novelty.basis: Substantially extends Fu-Li-Zuo with constructive arithmetic boundary proofs, explicit infinite modular obstruction families, exact rational covering densities, and certified power-substitution towers.

significance.basis: Provides definitive computational and formal resolution of irreducibility across expansive degrees for binary trinomials, advancing finite field arithmetic and coding theory tools.

reproducibility.basis: Complete cryptographic SHA-256 manifests provided for Lean 4 proof scripts, zero-float Python verification engine, and deterministic computational certificates.

summary: The paper presents four machine-checked structural and computational extensions to the recent elliptic-curve irreducibility criterion of Fu, Li, and Zuo for the binary trinomial family Tk(X). It establishes constructive arithmetic invariants in Lean 4, proves unconditional infinite modular obstruction families with precise rational covering densities, demonstrates exact F2[X] kernel-orbit distinct-degree factorizations matching theoretical predictions up to massive degrees via Lucas and Rabin certificates, and constructs certified power-substitution towers.
strengths: Unconditional formal verification of core arithmetic invariants and sieve properties in Lean 4.36.0 with 0 sorries.
Comprehensive cryptographic certificate suite (16 SHA-256 hashes) backed by adversarial unit testing.
Elegant synthesis of elliptic-curve torsion kernel-orbit partitions with explicit distinct-degree factorizations.
Clear delineation of trust boundaries across formal proofs, computational certificates, and cited literature.
weaknesses: Reliance on cited literature [1, Main Theorem A] for translating prime order certificates into polynomial irreducibility beyond degree 1366.
strong_novelty_candidates: Exact rational covering densities (1/2, 5/9, 53/90) eliminating composite trinomial indices via modular obstruction families.
Formal Lean 4 proof of exact lcm collapse under 6 | o and universal congruences.
